change.explanation: Group the real resource-offset computation (offset lookup and mode adjustment) in an inline helper; preserve the null guard, base-call order, widths and unsigned arithmetic. No scalar wrapper, identity helper, unused value, pragma or volatile was introduced.

experiments.stopping_condition: 32 smallest single-function source owners from the frozen before census, two-round maximum; stop first zero-yield round.
Two controls, one real adjusted-offset helper and two real quotient helper spellings, once.

validation: Independent line-by-line marker scan agrees with all 37 warning locations.
All 16733 initial finding source-line checks passed; source patch removes exactly one carrier review spot and no other category changes.
All 32 removal-only controls match; all 66 removals/combined removals are retained as nonmatching evidence.
Accepted resource-offset computation matches real MWCC object and relocations; no extra helper is emitted.
Both portable archives replayed all 103 bodies; programmatic source-SHA sets, exact verdicts and aligned error counts agree with the original reports.
limits: Warning spots are comments, not distinct devices. Multiple warnings can describe one device, and one warning can describe several.
Owners are physical TU-block owners or single-function source owners, not a complete call graph. Shared primers and headers can affect other consumers.
ADX dead-write uses are explicit device consumers. Other pragmas, volatile tokens and scalar-carrier shapes are review signals, not confirmed devices.
Source-form classification uses current configured retail functions and the existing reviewed assembly registry; C form does not certify natural C.
No preprocessor/call-graph or whole-project semantic audit is claimed. Unmarked devices and unresolved type/data ownership are not a certified total.
